records.jp: あ、詩帆さん
records.en_original: Oh, Shiho.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, Shiho.
records.en: Oh, Shiho-san.

records.jp: 星崎さん。<CR>…………大丈夫ですか？
records.en_original: Ao... Are you feeling all right?
records.en_auxiliary: Ao... Are you feeling all right?
records.en: Hoshizaki-san... Are you feeling all right?

records.jp: えっ？
records.en_original: Huh?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: あ、いや、ごめんなさい。<CR>顔色が良くないような気がして……
records.en_original: Oh, I'm sorry. I just thought that you looked a little pale...
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, I'm sorry. I just thought that you looked a little pale...
records.en: Oh, I'm sorry. I just thought that you looked a little pale...

records.jp: そう、かな。<CR>…………いや、そうかも
records.en_original: You think? ...Well, now that you mention it...
records.en_auxiliary: You think? ...Well, now that you mention it...
records.en: You think? ...Well, now that you mention it...

records.jp: ……ごめん。少し、話聞いてくれるかな？
records.en_original: Do you have some time to talk?
records.en_auxiliary: Do you have some time to talk?
records.en: Do you have some time to talk?

records.jp: もちろん。わたしでよければ
records.en_original: Of course. I'm always happy to talk.
records.en_auxiliary: Of course. I'm always happy to talk.
records.en: Of course. I'm always happy to talk.

records.jp: リーダーとしての責任、ですか。<CR>……難しい問題ですよね
records.en_original: You're worried about your responsibilities as the leader? Hmm, that is a tough one.
records.en_auxiliary: You're worried about your responsibilities as the leader? Hmm, that is a tough one.
records.en: You're worried about your responsibilities as the leader? Hmm, that is a tough one.

records.jp: うん……。<CR>どうすればよかったのか、分からなくなっちゃった
records.en_original: Yeah... I just don't know what to do anymore.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah... I just don't know what to do anymore.
records.en: Yeah... I just don't know what to do anymore.

records.jp: やっぱり……<CR>みんなの中心に立つのって、大変なんだと思います
records.en_original: I'm sure it's difficult being at the center of everything.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm sure it's difficult being at the center of everything.
records.en: I'm sure it's difficult being at the center of everything.

records.jp: 前に少しお話ししたことがありますよね。チームのこと
records.en_original: We talked a bit about my old team, didn't we?
records.en_auxiliary: We talked a bit about my old team, didn't we?
records.en: We talked a bit about my old team, didn't we?

records.jp: ああ、うん。きららと一緒の
records.en_original: Oh yeah. The one with Kirara.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh yeah. The one with Kirara.
records.en: Oh yeah. The one with Kirara.

records.jp: はい、そうです
records.en_original: Yes, exactly.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes, exactly.
records.en: Yes, exactly.

records.jp: ……そのチームにも、リーダーがいました
records.en_original: We also had a leader then.
records.en_auxiliary: We also had a leader then.
records.en: We also had a leader then.

records.jp: 話すと長くなるんですが……<CR>その人は、少し特殊で
records.en_original: It's a bit of a long story, but they were...special.
records.en_auxiliary: It's a bit of a long story, but they were...special.
records.en: It's a bit of a long story, but they were...special.

records.jp: わたしたちみたいな戦闘能力は、持っていない人でした
records.en_original: They were just like us, totally unable to fight in any way.
records.en_auxiliary: They were just like us, totally unable to fight in any way.
records.en: They were just like us, totally unable to fight in any way.

records.jp: え？　リーダーなのに……？
records.en_original: What? But weren't they the leader...?
records.en_auxiliary: What? But weren't they the leader...?
records.en: What? But weren't they the leader...?

records.jp: はい。でも……リーダーさんは、<CR>いつも自分にできることを探して、必死でした
records.en_original: They were... And that's why they were always frantically looking for things they could do to help.
records.en_auxiliary: They were... And that's why they were always frantically looking for things they could do to help.
records.en: They were... And that's why they were always frantically looking for things they could do to help.

records.jp: リーダーさんは、<CR>リーダーさんなりの方法で戦っていたんです
records.en_original: They found their own way to fight alongside us.
records.en_auxiliary: They found their own way to fight alongside us.
records.en: They found their own way to fight alongside us.

records.jp: だからわたしも、そんな彼の力になりたいと思って、<CR>いろいろとお手伝いをしたりしましたが――
records.en_original: So we all tried our best to find ways to help them too, but—
records.en_auxiliary: So we all tried our best to find ways to help them too, but—
records.en: So we all tried our best to find ways to help them too, but—

records.jp: 正直、あんまり力になれた気がしなくて
records.en_original: In the end, I don't know if we were very much help.
records.en_auxiliary: In the end, I don't know if we were very much help.
records.en: In the end, I don't know if we were very much help.

records.jp: それでも、何かできることはないかって探して……<CR>わたしなりにやってきたつもりです
records.en_original: Still, we kept on trying. We did what we could in our own way.
records.en_auxiliary: Still, we kept on trying. We did what we could in our own way.
records.en: Still, we kept on trying. We did what we could in our own way.

records.jp: 大切なのは……<CR>やり切ったと思えることではないでしょうか
records.en_original: I think the most important thing is the feeling of having done everything you can.
records.en_auxiliary: I think the most important thing is the feeling of having done everything you can.
records.en: I think the most important thing is the feeling of having done everything you can.

records.jp: その時、自分にできることはやり切った。<CR>そう思えたなら、わたしはそれでいいと思います
records.en_original: At the end of the day, if you can say that, I think that's plenty.
records.en_auxiliary: At the end of the day, if you can say that, I think that's plenty.
records.en: At the end of the day, if you can say that, I think that's plenty.

records.jp: ……そっか。うん……そうなのかもしれない
records.en_original: ...Yeah. You may be right.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Yeah. You may be right.
records.en: ...Yeah. You may be right.

records.jp: 星崎さんはあのクラックが起きて、<CR>動揺するみんなを引っ張ってくれました
records.en_original: You gave us direction when we were all panicking because of the Crack.
records.en_auxiliary: You gave us direction when we were all panicking because of the Crack.
records.en: When the Crack happened, you led everyone through their panic, Hoshizaki-san.

records.jp: あの時できる最善の行動だったと、わたしは思います。<CR>星崎さんは、間違っていません
records.en_original: I don't believe that was a mistake. You did the best thing you could have at the time.
records.en_auxiliary: I don't believe that was a mistake. You did the best thing you could have at the time.
records.en: I believe it was the best thing you could have done then. You weren't wrong, Hoshizaki-san.

records.jp: 詩帆さん……
records.en_original: Shiho...
records.en_auxiliary: Shiho...
records.en: Shiho-san...

records.jp: うん、ありがとう。<CR>なんか、元気出たかも
records.en_original: Thanks. That makes me feel a little better.
records.en_auxiliary: Thanks. That makes me feel a little better.
records.en: Thanks. That makes me feel a little better.

records.jp: ……あのクラックが起きてから、ずっと不安だった
records.en_original: I've been worried ever since that Crack appeared...
records.en_auxiliary: I've been worried ever since that Crack appeared...
records.en: I've been worried ever since that Crack appeared...

records.jp: 私、間違ってたのかなって。<CR>私のせいでみんなを危ない目に遭わせたんだって
records.en_original: I think I wrong. It's my fault that you were all put in danger.
records.en_auxiliary: I think I wrong. It's my fault that you were all put in danger.
records.en: I think I wrong. It's my fault that you were all put in danger.

records.jp: ……でも、なんだか今の言葉で、<CR>ちょっとだけ気が楽になった気がするよ
records.en_original: ...But I feel a little better after talking with you.
records.en_auxiliary: ...But I feel a little better after talking with you.
records.en: ...But I feel a little better after talking with you.

records.jp: はい。力になれたのならよかったです
records.en_original: Good. I'm glad I could be of help.
records.en_auxiliary: Good. I'm glad I could be of help.
records.en: Good. I'm glad I could be of help.

records.jp: ……さすが、前にもチームでやってただけはあるね。<CR>言われて嬉しい言葉が分かってる
records.en_original: It's nice talking with someone who has experience with this kind of thing. You always know just what to say to make me feel better.
records.en_auxiliary: It's nice talking with someone who has experience with this kind of thing. You always know just what to say to make me feel better.
records.en: It's nice talking with someone who has experience with this kind of thing. You always know just what to say to make me feel better.

records.jp: な、なんですか突然……！？
records.en_original: Wh-what's this all of a sudden—
records.en_auxiliary: Wh-what's this all of a sudden—
records.en: Wh-what's this all of a sudden—

records.jp: 嬉しかったから、嬉しい気持ちのお返しだよ
records.en_original: You cheered me up, so I wanted to share some of the joy.
records.en_auxiliary: You cheered me up, so I wanted to share some of the joy.
records.en: You cheered me up, so I wanted to share some of the joy.

records.jp: ほ、褒めても何も出ませんよ……？
records.en_original: F-flattery will get you nowhere, you know?
records.en_auxiliary: F-flattery will get you nowhere, you know?
records.en: F-flattery will get you nowhere, you know?

records.jp: ふふっ、今の表情が見れただけでも満足だよ。<CR>本当にありがとう、詩帆さん……
records.en_original: Hehe, that look on your face is all the reward I need. Seriously, thank you, Shiho.
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe, that look on your face is all the reward I need. Seriously, thank you, Shiho.
records.en: Hehe, that look on your face is all the reward I need. Seriously, thank you, Shiho-san.

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>自分にできること<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>What I Can Do<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en_auxiliary: Obtained <CLGR>What I Can Do<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained <CLGR>What I Can Do<CLNR> Fragment.
